best_validation.summary: 5/5 support pairs MATCH; all three R1 control candidates (contrast/JPEG/blur) produced mismatches and did not beat baseline

signal_sources: raw residual channel stds 33.2/23.1/39.7 vs YCrCb sev2 theory 34.7/23.3/42.2 (sigma_l=15.3, sigma_chroma=22.2) within 6%; sev3 theory 50.8/34.2/62.6 too high; sev1 isotropic 12.75 wrong fingerprint (x_distortion severity table: sigma_l=[0.05,0.06,0.07,0.08,0.09], chroma ratio=[1,1.45,1.9,2.35,2.8])
rgb_ratio=1.7221 (>1.4) + cross_channel_corr=0.1782 -> YCrCb; residual_intensity_corr=0.0013 (~0) -> not gamma

§B on raw residual: extreme_pct=51.34 (zero-mean-residual FP, no sparse salt&pepper), vm_slope=-7.016 (<0, not speckle), var_slope=0.4403 (<1.0, not poisson), spatial_corr=0.3424 (~iid expectation 1/3, no structure), rgb_ratio=1.7221 (>1.4, YCrCb)

variance_ratio=1.2596: mean residual noise var=(33.2^2+23.1^2+39.7^2)/3=1071; implied clean var ~1071/0.2596~4125 -> noise alone explains inflation; contrast_spread_ratio=1.203 and clipped_fraction=0.0524 are noise/clipping side effects

contrast control: mildest contrast_strengthen_scale sev1=1.4x -> predicted vr~1.4^2*1.2596~2.47; R1 test PARTIAL with global:variance_ratio diff=285% -> contrast rejected; contrast_weaken(0.75x) would give vr~0.82 << 1.26 and pairing with a higher noise severity violates the channel fingerprint
block_boundary=0.9956 (<1.05) + unique_G 256/256 + dct_zero_ratio=0.0197 -> no compression; R1 noise+JPEG:1 control WEAK (block_boundary diff=42%, noise:sigma diff=92%)

spectral_slope_ratio=0.9933 (<1.08) + FFT anisotropy=0.00 + no spatial residual structure -> no blur; R1 noise+blur_gaussian:1 control PARTIAL (noise:sigma diff=93%: blur-after-noise would collapse target sigma, incompatible with sigma reproduced by noise-only)
mean_shift=-0.5/255=0.002 (<0.005) -> no brightness (noise-robust signal); contrast control also matched global:mean_shift
reason: R1 signal reinterpretation re-examined all signals R0 leaned on plus the borderline ones R0 did not directly control (contrast, compression, blur). Baseline noise_gaussian_YCrCb:2 reproduced MATCH 2/2 on pair0 and 5/5 support pairs. The three control candidates all mismatched: contrast_strengthen_scale:1 variance_ratio +285%, compression_jpeg:1 block_boundary +42% / sigma +92%, blur_gaussian:1 sigma +93%. No candidate improved over the R0 baseline, and noise verdict cannot exceed UNCERTAIN (random seed), so the R0 pipeline is retained unchanged. R0 support PSNR 31.10 dB is consistent with the noise level (MSE floor ~1175 -> ~17.4 dB pre-restoration).
